Chapter 1 Introduction

This webbook provides all the code used in the analyses for the study “Micro-scale spatial metagenomics: revealing high-resolution spatial biogeography of gut microbiomes”. The project 3D’omics (http://www.3domics.eu) was Funded by European Union’s Horizon 2020 Research and Innovation programme.

1.1 Prepare the R environment

1.1.1 Environment

To reproduce all the analyses locally, clone this repository in your computer using:

RStudio > New Project > Version Control > Git

And indicating the following git repository:

https://github.com/3d-omics/MSSM.git

Once the R project has been created, follow the instructions and code chunks shown in this webbook.

1.1.2 Libraries

To keep installs out of your global R library, run this in the project before loading packages:

dir.create("r-lib", showWarnings = FALSE)
.libPaths(c(file.path(getwd(), "r-lib"), .libPaths()))

The packages below are required. Most install from CRAN or GitHub.

#install.packages('BiocManager', dependencies = TRUE)
# BiocManager::install(c("phyloseq", "ggtreeExtra","ggtree", "ALDEx2", "ComplexHeatmap"))

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman") 
# If the package is not installed, installs from CRAN 
pacman::p_load( tidyverse, jsonlite, ape, ggtree, phytools, ggnewscale, ggtreeExtra, ggpubr, broom, reshape2, zCompositions, ALDEx2, car, DHARMa, sjPlot, ggeffects, ggh4x, vegan, ggfortify, ggrepel, microbiome, ggforce, patchwork, grid, pheatmap, janitor, spdep, adespatial, adegraphics, ade4, magick, permuco, rmarkdown, purrr, PerformanceAnalytics, bookdown, htmlwidgets, webshot, kableExtra, hexbin, ComplexHeatmap, rstatix, circlize, scales) 
#If the package is not installed, installs from GitHub 
pacman::p_load_gh("anttonalberdi/hilldiv2", "anttonalberdi/distillR", "wilkelab/cowplot")

select <- dplyr::select
recode <- dplyr::recode
#install.packages("colorspace")
